note: Both clips are real synthesized speech (Groq Orpheus, canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english, voice 'autumn', 16kHz PCM16LE mono, matching the Adapter's fixed session config). UPDATED 2026-09-10 (see TASKS.md's 'Live re-verification, round 2' addendum): the original single-utterance brk_known_failure.wav (just 'I need the status of order BRK-71Q9.') was NOT a reliable way to reproduce a live mis-hearing — 5/5 careful runs transcribed it correctly, no repair triggered. It has been REPLACED with a genuine two-turn clip (see its own 'script' field below) built from audio that DOES reliably (5/5 live runs, both via raw WS streaming and via the real ?clip= demo-mode mechanism) reproduce the full live sequence: order id misheard -> lookup_order blocked (ENTITY_AMBIGUOUS) -> repair question asked -> caller repeats the disputed suffix -> entity verified -> lookup_order allowed. Building this exposed and fixed a real, separate bug in services/backend/src/reliability/repair/index.ts: real AssemblyAI transcribes a spoken character-by-character correction ('seven one Q nine') as ONE concatenated token ('71q9'), not four space-separated words the way the mocked test suite scripts it — the suffix-reconstruction parser only handled the latter shape and silently failed on the former, which would have escalated every real repair attempt of this kind. zxa_post_fix.wav is unchanged and still reliably (3/3 runs) produces a live ENTITY_AMBIGUOUS block, though it has not been tested end-to-end through a full repair-and-recover cycle.

clips.label: Demo Clip: BRK-71Q9 (known failure)
clips.script: Two turns in one file, matching a real caller's turn-taking: turn 1 says "order BRK-7109" (reliably transcribed by AssemblyAI exactly as spoken -- this is a genuinely misspoken/misremembered id from the caller, not a mis-hearing of the correct one); after a 1.5s pause, turn 2 says "seven one Q nine" (AssemblyAI transcribes this as the concatenated token "71q9", which the fixed repair parser now correctly reconstructs onto the known-good "BRK-" prefix as BRK-71Q9).
clips.role: DEMO.md Call B -- verified live 5/5 times (see TASKS.md): entity_detected BRK-7109 -> action_blocked ENTITY_AMBIGUOUS -> repair_question asked -> entity_detected/resolved BRK-71Q9 -> action_allowed with the real order record. This is a real, reproducible live sequence, not merely what the mocked test suite scripts.
